intro: Portland's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $136/month, down 2.9% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). Storage Stats puts the Portland metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $150, down 8% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $139. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $57 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$59.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $81 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$86. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $136, down 2.9% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). Storage Stats Portland metro non-climate asking rent $150, down 8% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Portland alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$139.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $181 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$175.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $237 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$230.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Cully (~$82), West Centennial (~$91), South Tabor (~$121) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. North Central Gresham (~$282) is among the highest.
Portland has about 74 facilities and 4.5 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
